review.compatibilityReason: CAgent reliability changes preserve existing JSON/SQLite record shapes and DATA_EPOCH=1. MCP cancellation signals and task schedule ownership are runtime-only; terminal task states reject late callbacks without adding status values. The shared atomic-write primitive owns a unique temporary file and removes only that file on failure, adding one generic-safe-fs cleanup site. No persisted field, store ownership, or data path changes. GitHub issue fixes change only plugin load/unload timing, generation ownership, public HTTP response projection, and desktop clipboard IPC. Installed plugin paths/manifests/receipts, download cache naming, desktop window/version state, SQLite schemas, write-site ownership, and DATA_EPOCH=1 remain unchanged. Reviewed source digest changes: desktop/main.cjs, core/plugin-manager.ts, server/routes/plugins.ts. Session snapshot safety keeps the same JSONL entry schema and branch IDs. Full rewrites now serialize before atomic replacement and refuse snapshots missing on-disk entries; repair writes check the previously read bytes. The session-jsonl writer changes from write-file to atomic-write with unchanged store ownership, paths, SQLite schemas, 787 write sites, and DATA_EPOCH=1. Reviewed session-jsonl-file.ts and session-inline-media-prune.ts source digest changes. CAgent update sources now use the owner Gitee repository. The optional update-channel JSON gains a repository ownership marker so legacy upstream invitation records are ignored; old records remain readable and unmodified until an explicit channel activation. No required fields, database schemas, store ownership, or DATA_EPOCH changes.
